tool_args.rationale: The expanded archive directly maps the thermal-fin bridge to the two-layer inland-hub siphon. Its saturating source, bounded sink inhibition, and additive branch explain the observed dependencies and address the previously refuted separable model.

considered_alternatives.option: Separable saturating source and sink model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE was 0.054143, above the 0.045 tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Inland-hub siphon with square-root or linear branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both are retained as candidate branches; numerical training error selects between them.
The existing observations span source strength and sink gradient, sufficient to fit the identified static bridge law; the nuisance probe is irrelevant.
